featured_reviews.name: steve dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re even remotely serious about your craft, do yourself a favour and stay away from this place. This is not a professional studio, it’s a venue awkwardly pretending to be one.

We shot at Studio 3 and the constant banging noises from the neighbouring facility made it borderline unusable for any sound recording. When this was brought up to the staff, instead of resolving it, they casually pointed at a board and told us to “call the manager.” So in the middle of an active shoot, we’re expected to call someone who isn’t even on-site, only to be told in a condescending tone that it’s from an establishment called Candies next door which which has an operational kitchen as if that somehow fixes the problem.

What’s worse is the on-ground staff hovering and staring at the backdrop roll while the talent is literally mid-shot on it. In any professional studio, you get reasonable usage of the roll and pay extra if needed, you don’t get policed like you’re damaging museum property. Having staff silently stare down your talent during a take is not just unprofessional, it’s absurd.

We also shot BTS and bytes in the common couch area, which they themselves position as a usable space, only for the hiring team to get a CCTV monitoring call saying they’ll be charged for sitting on the couch because it’s a “prop.” Monitoring clients over CCTV to penalise basic usage of space is petty and ridiculous.

I’ve shot in dozens of studios, some great, some average, some difficult, but never one that felt this hostile, rigid, and poorly managed. Issues usually get solved through competent studio management. Here, the owner or manager Vicky seems fundamentally unsuited to run a studio environment.

For the price they charge, you can easily book a larger, better-equipped studio with proper sound control, basic professionalism, and staff who actually understand how shoots function. This place is a logistical headache masquerading as a studio.

featured_reviews.name: Michika Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
Lavanya and her team were truly a dream come true for us. From the very first conversation to our wedding day, they were so incredibly accommodating, kind, and thoughtful. Amidst all the emotions, nerves, and excitement, they brought such a calm and reassuring presence that made everything feel effortless.

They did a brilliant job capturing every emotion — the happy tears, the laughter, the quiet in-between moments, and all the joy that filled the day. Every time I look through our images, it genuinely feels like I’m reliving that beautiful day all over again. It’s hard to believe that it’s going to be a year since, yet the emotions come rushing back so vividly through their work.

We will forever be grateful to Lavanya and her incredible team for preserving our memories so beautifully. Choosing them was one of the best decisions we made for our wedding, and we cannot recommend them enough.

featured_reviews.name: Nyomi Bhathena
featured_reviews.review_text:
From the very first message, working with Lavanya and KOMO Studios was a dream. Their end-to-end coordination is flawless — from the way they present their packages and pricing, to the constant communication leading up to the day, and the thoughtful briefing where they take time to understand exactly what you want. I loved being able to share example shots and see them tailor their style while still adding their own professional flair. They are absolute masters of candid photography, which is perfect for detail-oriented couples who want both precision and soul in their photos.

On the wedding day, Lavanya and her team were nothing short of incredible — kind, calm, and flexible no matter what came up. They made not just us, but our families and friends feel at ease, and by the end it honestly felt like they were part of our friend group. They captured not only us as a couple, but every emotion and smile of our guests, which means so much as those are the memories we’ll cherish forever.

Even afterwards, KOMO Studios’ professionalism shines through. The way they deliver photos and videos is stunning — beautifully presented, easy to review, and always accommodating of feedback. The tools used to deliver the photos and create your wedding photo album are absolutely stunning and so user friendly, we were very impressed.

They strike the perfect balance between their creative artistry and your personal story. We’ve loved them so much that they’ve now become the official photographers of our entire friend group and family! If you’re looking for heartfelt, natural, and truly candid photography, I cannot recommend Lavanya and KOMO Studios highly enough.

featured_reviews.name: Myron Dcruz
featured_reviews.review_text: Lavanya and her team were absolutely outstanding! They captured every moment of our wedding with such elegance and creativity, turning memories into timeless art. Beyond their talent, they were a delight to work with — professional, warm, and always attentive. We couldn’t have asked for a better photographer to make our day so special.

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Narvekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amazing experience working with Lavanya and her team for our wedding in Mumbai. The quality of the photos and videos is outstanding and really brings back the happiest memories of our lives! Wedding planning can often be stressful but with Komo studios, we didn’t have to worry about the photos at all.

The team was professional, considerate of our needs, and not intrusive all at the same time. We enjoyed our wedding days to the fullest without having to pause at special moments to look into a camera, yet, having those moments captured in photos all the same.

Highly Highly recommend Komo studios!!

featured_reviews.name: Zenia Gheewala
featured_reviews.review_text: We had such an amazing experience working with Lavanya. We are so happy we got to have her and her team shoot our wedding day. From start to finish the whole process was flawless and such a breeze. Lavanya and her team are punctual, hard working and passionate and their attention to detail  shows in their work. We wanted a combination of portraits and candid pictures and that's exactly what they delivered. Cannot recommend them enough!!

featured_reviews.name: rafael pereira
featured_reviews.review_text:
In a month it will be 2 years since Lavanya first etched moments into memories for Manali & me. We chose KOMO because Lavanya understood what we wanted, was clear with what she wouldn't do, accommodated our budget, and dealt with us in the most professional yet caring way possible. She kept us comfortable and made sure that we were having
fun rather than posing. No matter the last minute request or hurdle, she and team KOMO took it in their stride to go above and beyond our expectations. If you think this review is written by a bot using chat GPT, I invite you to verify our albums, walls, social media profiles, and even my LinkedIn speaker announcements. All those stunners aren't by my AI enabled Hasselblad One Plus, they are KOMO. I don't know why it has taken us so long to write this review, I guess I just thought Lavanya's pictures said enough.

featured_reviews.name: Bhavesh Bajaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
We absolutely loved Lavanya's pictures and her work.

In our first meeting while interacting with her, we knew she was the perfect fit for covering our wedding. She is an absolute gem to work with. She made us feel at ease and got everything covered. She understood all our requirements, learnt all the rituals and also managed to do a professional set-up for a zoom wedding for the people who couldn't attend. The last thing we had to worry about was photography.

Lavanya perfectly captured the candid of the couple as well as family the wedding and it's a delight to revisit wedding photos every time.

Thank you so much Lavanya for creating such wonderful memories through your lenses. Would highly recommend.

featured_reviews.name: Mayuri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Fun, professional and magical.

If you are looking for someone to 'take' your wedding pictures 'for' you, there are a bunch of people out there. If, however, you want someone to 'create' your wedding pictures 'with' you, Lavanya is the one you should contact.
Lavanya is very easy and comfortable to work with. She is GIFTED. She develops an effortless camaraderie with the couple which makes the whole process very pleasant and positive!
Lavanya and her team are a young talented bunch of female photographers, Women Power!!Who bring fresh energetic and fun vibe to the events. I would recommend Lavanya to anyone looking for a very real and effortless capture to their wedding! Her planning, execution everything was just so perfect, my husband and I were extremely relaxed as we knew our wedding is in good hands 😊
The only problem we have encountered is trying to choose our favorites, because there are just so many amazing shots.
Thankyou Lavanya for the best experience for which we are extremely grateful. I knew you were the one who would shoot our wedding the very first day I spoke with you and I wouldn’t have had it in any other setting. 😊

featured_reviews.name: Joel Dcunha
featured_reviews.review_text:
I do not recommend hiring Jude for any event, especially weddings. It has been over a year since our wedding, and we still have not received the promised wedding videos or albums.

Jude requested almost full payment the night before the wedding, which had not been discussed earlier, creating an unprofessional and rushed feeling. Despite assurances that the work would be completed on time, he has since given multiple excuses, such as “bad internet,” when we inquired about the videos. More recently, he claimed his videographer has the videos and is not providing them. When asked about a backup, he stated that he doesn’t keep one due to managing many clients.

When we’ve asked for updates, Jude has become unresponsive, often avoiding calls and messages. I even called him from a different number, and when he recognized my voice, he pretended to have a poor connection and disconnected the call. He has since stopped responding and directed his wife to handle communications.

This experience has been extremely disappointing, and the lack of follow-through has left us feeling misled. If you’re looking for reliable and professional service, I strongly recommend considering other options. This has been a stressful and unsatisfactory experience. Please DO NOT be swayed by the 5-star ratings.

featured_reviews.name: Shuvam Misra
featured_reviews.review_text: I get 35mm film from Dave Brothers and also get rolls developed. They have worked with my colour and B&W film, and as far as I can see, their work is as good as the best which I've got elsewhere. (I used to get my film developed by an outlet in Dadar before, but their development gave me much lower contrast negatives.) I've also bought respooled bulk B&W film stock from Dave Brothers, and it's turned out to be excellent. All in all, I'm very happy and will recommend highly.
